user.phase1_limit: Phase 1 limit: up to {refs} references and €{budget} per user. References costing €1.35 or less must be ordered in multiples of 25 (minimum 25); more expensive references in multiples of 10.

insights.title: Analytics dashboard
insights.subtitle_admin: Overview of the group order: commitments, orders and participation.
insights.subtitle_personal: Your commitments and orders for this campaign.
insights.disclaimer: Votes represent commitments, not orders or payments. Amounts use current catalog prices; taxes, shipping and final-order adjustments are excluded.
insights.empty: There is no data for this section yet.
sim.title: Full order simulator
sim.subtitle: Explore a fictional campaign from catalog creation to final reconciliation. Adjust the inputs and regenerate any time.
sim.safe: No real participants, orders or campaign data are used. SQLite and the active campaign remain unchanged.
insights.cutoff_note: Informational ranking based on current voting units. It does not finalize the top 85 or change commitments. Ties are sorted by internal ID.
sim.stage1.title: Setup
sim.stage1.detail: Create a fictional campaign, a budget for each participant and a sample catalog.
sim.stage2.title: Catalog
sim.stage2.detail: Simulate parts, colors and entirely invented prices.
sim.stage3.title: Voting
sim.stage3.detail: Each participant votes without exceeding their fictional budget.
sim.stage4.title: Top 85 cutoff
sim.stage4.detail: Keep the 85 most-voted references and fully release commitments for discarded parts.
sim.stage5.title: Reconciliation
sim.stage5.detail: Retained commitments are mandatory minimums and can never decrease.
sim.stage6.title: Final orders
sim.stage6.detail: Add optional quantities while respecting retained commitments and individual limits.
sim.stage7.title: Preparation and payments
sim.stage7.detail: Illustrative fictional preparation and payment events; no transactions or invoices are created.
sim.stage8.title: Closing and audit
sim.stage8.detail: Verify financial reconciliation and that no order falls below its retained commitments.
insights82.budget_note: Based on actual orders; votes are not orders.
insights82.no_history: The series begins with the first capture. Earlier values are not fabricated.
insights82.timeline_note: Points are actual captures, not a complete log of every change.
insights82.years_note: Campaigns without historical captures show no data.
insights82.no_cutoff: There are not yet more than 85 references.
insights82.alerts_note: Informational: ties are ordered by ID. Does not change official selection.
